{"idea":"All denominators are positive, so clear them and simplify the inequality to a nonnegative quadratic expression. Positivity of x, y, and z makes every resulting term nonnegative.","proof":"rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
have hxy : 0 < x + y := add_pos hx hy
have hyz : 0 < y + z := add_pos hy hz
have hzx : 0 < z + x := add_pos hz hx
have hxyz : 0 < x + y + z := add_pos hxy hz
have hden : 0 < (x + y + z) * (x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x) := by positivity
field_simp
nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hx)) (sq_nonneg (y - z)),
  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hy)) (sq_nonneg (z - x)),
  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hz)) (sq_nonneg (x - y))]","insight_statement":"","insight_proof":""}
